LoginBody.title: LoginBody
LoginBody.description:
Request body for the `/login` endpoint.

## Example

```json
{
  "username": "admin",
  "password": "public"
}
```

SubscribeBody.title: SubscribeBody
SubscribeBody.description:
Request body for creating a subscription for a client.

## Example

```json
{
  "topic": "sensors/#",
  "qos": 1
}
```

PublishBody.title: PublishBody
PublishBody.description:
Request body for publishing a message.

## Example

```json
{
  "topic": "sensors/temp",
  "payload": "{\"temperature\": 25.5}",
  "qos": 1,
  "retain": false
}
```

CreateRuleBody.title: CreateRuleBody
CreateRuleBody.description: Request body for creating or updating a rule.

CreateAuthUserBody.description: Request body for creating an auth user.

is_superuser.description: Whether the user is a superuser.

CreateBanBody.description: Request body for creating a ban.

NodeInfo.title: NodeInfo
NodeInfo.description:
Information about a single EMQX node.

## Example

```json
{
  "node": "emqx@127.0.0.1",
  "version": "5.0.0",
  "uptime": 86400000,
  "status": "running",
  "memory_total": 1073741824,
  "memory_used": 536870912,
  "connections": 1000
}
```

ListNodesResponse.title: ListNodesResponse
ListNodesResponse.description: Response from `/nodes` endpoint - list of cluster nodes.

data.description: List of nodes in the cluster.

node.description: Node the client is connected to.

PaginationMeta.title: PaginationMeta
PaginationMeta.description:
Pagination metadata in EMQX list responses.

## Example

```json
{
  "count": 100,
  "limit": 100,
  "page": 1,
  "hasnext": true
}
```

clientid.description: Client ID that owns the subscription.

RuleInfo.title: RuleInfo
RuleInfo.description:
Rule definition.

## Example

```json
{
  "id": "temp_alert",
  "sql": "SELECT * FROM \"sensors/+/temp\" WHERE payload.value > 100",
  "actions": [{"function": "republish", "args": {"topic": "alerts/temp"}}],
  "enabled": true
}
```

is_superuser.description: Whether the user is a superuser.
